metadata.description: Claude Code skills shared from Nick Porcaro's setup: project doc loops, an item-store tracker, git worktree batches, build-test-fix iteration, and a couple of utilities.

plugins.name: project-docs
plugins.description: Orient, record, and audit a project whose state lives in history.md, TODO.md and README.md: /wherex, /updatex, /addtodo, /planning-review, /updateplan.

plugins.name: item-tracker
plugins.description: The same loop for a repo tracking work as one markdown file per item under items/, where each file's status: field is the source of truth: /whereitems, /additem, /updateitems, /updateitemplan, /planning-items-review.

plugins.name: worktree-batch
plugins.description: Git worktrees as disposable workspaces plus batches of unattended jobs that accumulate on one branch: /mkwt, /wtmerge, /fwtmerge, /projectreview, /sequencework.

plugins.name: iterate
plugins.description: Build-test-fix loops that keep going until the change actually works, driven through the project's own test automation: /itrm macOS, /itri iOS device, /itrs iOS Simulator, /itrp macOS with plugin formats.

plugins.name: dev-utils
plugins.description: Two standalone utilities: /commit matches the repo's own commit-subject convention, /diskusage surveys a Mac's disk in safety tiers and never deletes without approval.
